comparison_controls: Both frozen PMPose/Sapiens2 detections; body PMPose old wrist prior enabled vs new disabled, not controlled A/B. No Sapiens2 new body result.
success: same-run scene/body/strict gate exported; browser mesh and controls work; report all label/geometry failures and distinguish residuals from independent truth
stop: missing source or inconsistent arrays blocks viewer; no relabeling, deletion, relaxed gate, or substituted body result
additional_readonly_control: Existing pmpose_baseline vs pmpose_no_wrist from G20261003_smplh_ablation_v1; resolved options differ only output_dir,wrist_reference,wrist_reference_weight
anomaly_policy: 100px diagnostic flags only; no exclusion. Labels/points/failed geometry retained.
report_only_inputs: Existing detector-manual comparison JSONs, actual raw detector sources/calibrations, frozen old/new body results, existing old wrist ablations
interpretation: Elbow has no manual truth; report only fit-observation disagreement. Camera/extrinsics and manual wrist prior differ across captures.
